78. National Waterway 78 _Penganga Wardha River System:_

Confluence of Aran and Penganga rivers near Chimata village at
Lat 19[o]54‟08”N, Lon 78[o]12‟36”E to the confluence of Wardha
and Pranahita rivers near Ravalli village at Lat 19[o]33‟59”N, Lon
79[o]49‟0”E.
